If your children are preparing to go back to school or heading to university, taking advantage of back-to-school season discounts to pick up tech products to help them with their studies is the perfect choice.

Apple launched its own back-to-school promotion last month, offering a US$150 gift card with the purchase of a qualifying Mac or iPad, and Amazon also has plenty of great deals.

We've curated a selection of essential tech products for back-to-school, listed below for your reference.

inateck AceTouch——Ultra-lightweight colourful keyboard case for iPad

If you want to add a case, screen protector, stand and keyboard to your iPad at an affordable price, the inateck AceTouch is for you. It can transform your iPad into a laptop, allowing you to work easily anywhere.

The keyboard is the accessory that best boosts iPad productivity, and the AceTouch is a full-featured keyboard with a Mac-like design, complete with function keys and a clickable trackpad (98x55mm) that supports all Apple shortcuts. You can use the trackpad to drag, scroll, zoom, swipe between full-screen apps and more. The Palm Rejection feature prevents accidental touches.

Snap it on for laptop mode, snap it off for tablet mode.

The magnetic detachable design lets the keyboard attach automatically, and detaching takes just one second. Combined with a flexible stand adjustable from 20 to 70 degrees, supporting both landscape and portrait orientations, one case handles any usage scenario.

The AceTouch is 200 grams lighter than other full-featured keyboards, weighing only 450 grams with a thickness of just 0.3 inches, featuring scissor-switch keys with 1.5mm short travel for fast and comfortable input. At this light weight, slipping it into any bag for daily carry is no problem at all.

It's compatible with the iPad (A16) 11th generation, 10th-generation iPad, 10.9-inch iPad Air (4th and 5th generation), 11-inch iPad Air (M2 to M4), and 11-inch iPad Pro (1st to 4th generation).

Pick your colour. Show your style. This keyboard features a modern minimalist aesthetic, available in nine vibrant colours, and combined with its lightweight design, adds personality to your iPad.

Anker Nano Power Strip

The Anker Nano Power Strip is an ultra-compact ten-in-one desktop charging device that can power various Apple devices simultaneously.

It features a clever clamp design that securely attaches to your desired position, hiding the main unit under the desk. The exposed portion is smaller than an iPhone 17 Pro Max and thinner than AirPods Pro 3.

You can charge your MacBook, monitor, iPad, iPhone, AirPods and other devices simultaneously through a combination of power outlets and USB ports. GaN charging technology delivers up to 70W output, along with built-in surge and overload protection that instantly cuts power when triggered, keeping all your devices safe.

ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station

If you want to set up a neat charging station at your bedside for your main Apple devices, the ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods case simultaneously.

The Qi 2.2 charger delivers up to 25W output for the latest iPhone models, and is of course also compatible with all older MagSafe iPhones. Built-in CryoBoost cooling reduces phone temperature during charging, extending battery life. The fan can be turned off for silent nighttime operation.

It supports all Apple Watch models, as well as all AirPods cases with wireless charging. This device is also ideal for travel, folding down to just 4.33 x 2.44 x 0.62 inches.

Apple AirPods Max 2

The AirPods Max 2 is the latest generation of Apple's premium over-ear headphones, featuring Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Adaptive Audio, personalised spatial audio, real-time translation and more.

The headphones combine a breathable mesh headband, memory foam, custom-woven ear cushions, and an extendable sliding arm design for the perfect balance of comfort and fit. They're available in five vibrant colours.

Anker Soundcore Liberty 5

AirPods are undoubtedly one of the most popular in-ear headphones, but if you're looking for a more affordable alternative, the Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 noise-cancelling earbuds are a solid choice.

They combine real-time adaptive active noise cancellation, fast charging and long-lasting battery life. When listening to music, hi-res audio, LDAC, HearID Sound 4.0 and Dolby Audio work together to enhance sound quality and depth. When taking calls, six microphones work with AI-enhanced active noise cancellation for clearer calls. Multi-point connectivity lets you switch quickly and easily between devices.

The earbuds last up to 12 hours on a single charge, extending to 48 hours with the charging case. A 10-minute charge gives you 5 hours of use.

AirTags 2nd Generation 4-Pack

AirTags are a great way to track valuables or important items like bags and cameras when you're out and about. This deal lets you grab the latest 2nd-generation 4-pack at a superb price.

MagSafe PopSockets

PopSockets are one of the most popular iPhone accessories right now, not only helping you grip your iPhone securely with one hand, but also doubling as a stand.

The metal enamel finish gives a clean, premium look, with a variety of colours and patterns to choose from.

Oeli XTREM iPhone Case with E-ink Display

Last but not least, here's an interesting option. The Oeli XTREM is a one-of-a-kind iPhone case: it has a built-in electronic ink (E-ink) display that can be customised through a dedicated app.

It requires no battery and is powered by your phone's NFC. Like other E-ink displays, it uses no power to display images, only consuming power when refreshing, so the impact on your phone's battery is virtually negligible.

You can choose your own photos, or designs created by others in the app's community. You can also use it to mirror your iPhone screen to the display, for taking selfies with the rear camera.
